d.title: Kuroko no Basket: Baka ja Katenai no yo!
d.jp: 黒子のバスケ バカじゃ勝てないのよ!
syn: Kuroko's Basketball: A Monkey Can't Win!
d.synopsis: Bundled with the 25th volume of Kuroko no Basket manga. The anime based on the Baka Ja Katenai no yo (バカじゃ勝てないのよ) story that was featured in the manga's fifth volume.
